decisions.reason: Still only mentioned and overlapping with the flagship insole, which could trigger rationalization, but slack and no clear performance shortfall support carrying it.
Like the comfort insole, its limited web presence and overlap with the flagship keep a moderate rationalization risk, yet organisational slack allows it to remain while results stay uncertain.
Its own website page signals strategic priority and likely above-aspiration performance, so problemistic search is unlikely to target it.
It fits the firm's protective niche and shows no evidence of a shortfall, so slack supports continuing it.
As the home-page flagship and stated direction of the firm, it is highly unlikely to be dropped.
